BERT MITCHELL, always associated with our Club Marathon Championship Shield, paid us a visit on the occasion of the 20 Miles Open Run and promises that his next visit to Wimbledon will not be so long delayed.

The "Mitchell Trophy"is being awarded by the donor of this magnificent shield, Bert Mitchell of 32, Manor Road, Deal. Bert was formerly a fierce competitor and still remains a staunch Belgrave Harrier.
In addition to the letters read out, a number of members had let us know that they could not attend. Bert Mitchell, one of our earliest marathon runners who now lives in Deal.
